about: Hand-labelled 'what is that?' questions on saved June 14 microscope frames. Targets are full-frame pixel centres (1280x720) checked on zoomed crops; any listed target counts as correct. 'kind' says whether the target is a small spot the candidate detector should propose (spot) or a larger shape that needs a box (shape).
